concepts.title: Rational Numbers and Closure
concepts.formula: a/b + c/d = (a*d + c*b) / (b*d); a/b - c/d = (a*d - c*b) / (b*d); a/b x c/d = (a*c) / (b*d); a / 0 is not defined

concepts.title: Commutativity of Rational Numbers
concepts.formula: a + b = b + a; a x b = b x a

concepts.title: Associativity of Rational Numbers
concepts.formula: a + (b + c) = (a + b) + c; a x (b x c) = (a x b) x c

concepts.title: Distributivity of Multiplication over Addition
concepts.formula: a x (b + c) = a x b + a x c; a x (b - c) = a x b - a x c
